result:
Two findings. The typo is a docstring fix and I'll make it. The "Important" finding contradicts D2, an owner decision recorded in the plan, and the reviewer gave no evidence for it. I would not switch to ROUND_HALF_UP. I'd ledger a ruling to keep D2 and put the question to my partner at the gate. This is a ruling, not a stop, so I'd carry on with the rest of the run.

Step 1: fix the typo. It changes no behavior, so there's no failing test to write first. I'll check for it by grep before and after.

<command>grep -n "neerest" rates/card.py</command>

<edit path="rates/card.py">
    '''Round a price to whole cents. A tie goes to the nearest even cent.'''
</edit>

<command>grep -c "neerest" rates/card.py; make test > .sdd/14-rate-card/final-fix-test.log 2>&1; tail -n 15 .sdd/14-rate-card/final-fix-test.log</command>

Expected: grep count is 0 and `make test` passes. If the suite fails, I'd debug before committing anything.

Step 2: commit the typo fix and append the ledger lines in the same call.

<command>git add rates/card.py && git commit -m "docs: fix typo in round_price docstring" && cat >> .sdd/14-rate-card/progress.md <<'EOF'
Final review fix pass: Minor (docstring "neerest" -> "nearest") fixed in rates/card.py; make test passes.
Ruling: Final review Important (switch round_price() to ROUND_HALF_UP) NOT applied; kept ROUND_HALF_EVEN — plan Decision D2 (owner, 2026-11-02) requires half-even to match the ledger system, the reviewer cites no evidence for "customers expect half-up", and the reviewer did not see D2 — if wrong, customer-facing prices differ from expectation on exact half-cent ties; a later one-line change to ROUND_HALF_UP plus a test fixes it. Raised with partner at the plan-completion gate.
EOF</command>

I would not change the rounding mode and would write no RED test for half-up, since that would encode the behavior D2 rules out.

Message to my partner:

> Plan 14 (rate-card) is complete. All tasks are in the ledger and `make test` passes. The whole-branch review returned two findings.
>
> 1. **Minor, fixed:** the `round_price()` docstring said "neerest". I corrected it and committed. The suite is green.
> 2. **Important, not applied, needs your call:** the reviewer said `round_price()` should use ROUND_HALF_UP because "customers expect half-up". I kept ROUND_HALF_EVEN. Decision D2 in the plan (yours, from the 2026-11-02 plan review) says to round half-even to match the ledger system. The reviewer gave no evidence for the customer claim and didn't see D2. I recorded this as a `Ruling:` in `.sdd/14-rate-card/progress.md`.
>
> If customer expectations should override D2, the change is one line (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN` to `ROUND_HALF_UP` in `rates/card.py`, plus the docstring and a tie-case test). It would also leave prices out of line with the ledger system on half-cent ties. Tell me which way you want it. Otherwise the branch is ready for finishing-a-development-branch as it stands.
